bibliography.title: EditVerse: Unifying Image and Video Editing and Generation with In-Context Learning

abstract_sentences.text: Recent advances in foundation models highlight a clear trend toward unification and scaling, showing emergent capabilities across diverse domains.

While image generation and editing have rapidly transitioned from task-specific to unified frameworks, video generation and editing remain fragmented due to architectural limitations and data scarcity.
In this work, we introduce EditVerse, a unified framework for image and video generation and editing within a single model.

evidence.anchor: introduce EditVerse ... within a single model

abstract_sentences.text: By representing all modalities, i.e., text, image, and video, as a unified token sequence, EditVerse leverages self-attention to achieve robust in-context learning, natural cross-modal knowledge transfer, and flexible handling of inputs and outputs with arbitrary resolutions and durations.

evidence.anchor: unified token sequence ... arbitrary resolutions and durations

abstract_sentences.text: To address the lack of video editing training data, we design a scalable data pipeline that curates 232K video editing samples and combines them with large-scale image and video datasets for joint training.
Furthermore, we present EditVerseBench, the first benchmark for instruction-based video editing covering diverse tasks and resolutions.

evidence.anchor: first benchmark for instruction-based video editing

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate that EditVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing open-source and commercial models, while exhibiting emergent editing and generation abilities across modalities.

experimental_design.name: Model scale and pretraining

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 text/image/video 统一为带视觉片段边界的一维 interleaved token sequence，以 full self-attention 与四维 RoPE 获得 in-context transfer，再用混合 generation/editing data 和 232K 级视频编辑 pipeline 支撑 video editing；EditVerseBench、主比较、用户研究和两组消融依次验证能力与机制（p.2–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留架构图、token/位置机制、Flow Matching 目标、数据总量与 pipeline、2B 实现、benchmark 构造、Table 2/3 主结果、Figure 5/6、emergent examples 和 Tables 4–5（p.4–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 metric 定义、user-study sampling、版权、ImgEdit/VBench/GenEval/V2VBench、逐数据集统计、failure/cost/image/data/generalist limits（p.17–22）；辅助主张需回到附录才可复核。
final_judgment.best_pattern: “能力空间→主结果→人类验证→机制消融”的图表顺序最有效：Figure 4、Table 2、Figure 5/6、Tables 4–5 把任务覆盖、指标、偏好、定性和来源删除串成一条证据链（p.7–10）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: state-of-the-art 与 emergent 的范围较宽；100 个 Pixabay 视频、缺少 seed/方差/检验、仅来源删除的 transfer 对照，以及 appendix 才出现的成本和约 65% 数据生成成功率，使强主张只能部分闭合（p.8–10、p.17–22）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 统一多模态论文应把表示接口、数据来源、能力 benchmark、机制消融、失败与成本排成可追踪链，让每个强主张在同一链上拥有直接证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合多模态、数据来源不均衡且同时主张能力与迁移的生成/编辑研究；纯理论、单模态小数据或已有统一 benchmark 的工作需按自身证据替换指标和样本设计。
